item.title: Spain set to block EU tobacco tax directive over rolling tobacco
item.description: Spain is reportedly threatening to block the EU’s proposed Tobacco Tax Directive unless minimum excise rates on rolling tobacco are reduced. (Published on November 04, 2026byclearingtheair.eu)

item.title: The Twelve Truths of Tobacco Harm Reduction
item.description: Six weeks without cigarettes followed by a return to smoking should raise questions about what changed, rather than simply being recorded as an unsuccessful quit attempt. (Published on November 04, 2026bysubstack.com)
